name: hpac-safety-tooling
description: Repository-wide TypeScript tooling: ESLint (strict, type-checked) over src/web, tools, tests/js and tests/e2e (ADR-0188), and tsc over tools and tests/js, which Node runs by type stripping (ADR-0189), and over the browser suite, which Playwright transpiles without checking. The web app's own dependencies stay in src/web/package.json and the browser suite's in tests/e2e/package.json; the type-aware rules read both.
